name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: The trail back up a record hierarchy, e.g. Library / Reports / Q3. Routing agnostic: pass `href` for anchors, `onSelect` for buttons. The last item is always the current page (aria-current), not a link. Replaces the old habit of faking a breadcrumb with a subtitle string. Copy: each crumb is the page's own title, unshortened. A trail that renames its steps is a trail the reader cannot match to whe
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Breadcrumb.json
